+    def solve(data):
+        packages = data["packages"]
+        names = sorted(packages)
+        features = set(data.get("features", []))
+        blocked = data.get("blocked", {})
+        pins = data.get("pins", {})
+        roots = data["roots"]
+        best_vector = None
+        best_install = None
+
+        def search(assignments, constraints):
+            nonlocal best_vector, best_install
+            for name, version in assignments.items():
+                if any(not low <= version <= high
+                       for low, high in constraints.get(name, [])):
+                    return
+            pending = [name for name in constraints if name not in assignments]
+            if not pending:
+                # Every selected row contributes its active edges; reject cycles.
+                edges = {}
+                for name, version in assignments.items():
+                    row = next(row for row in packages[name]
+                               if row["version"] == version)
+                    edges[name] = [dep["name"] for dep in row.get("deps", [])
+                                   if not dep.get("feature")
+                                   or dep.get("feature") in features]
+                finished, active = set(), set()
+
+                def visit(name):
+                    if name in active:
+                        return False
+                    if name in finished:
+                        return True
+                    active.add(name)
+                    if any(not visit(other) for other in edges.get(name, [])):
+                        return False
+                    active.remove(name)
+                    finished.add(name)
+                    return True
+
+                if not all(visit(name) for name in edges):
+                    return
+                vector = tuple(assignments[name] if name in assignments else -1
+                               for name in names)
+                if best_vector is None or vector > best_vector:
+                    best_vector = vector
+                    best_install = dict(assignments)
+                return
+
+            name = min(pending)
+            rows = [row for row in packages[name]
+                    if row["version"] not in blocked.get(name, [])
+                    and (name not in pins or row["version"] == pins[name])
+                    and all(low <= row["version"] <= high
+                            for low, high in constraints[name])]
+            for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda item: item["version"], reverse=True):
+                new_assignments = dict(assignments)
+                new_assignments[name] = row["version"]
+                new_constraints = {key: list(value)
+                                   for key, value in constraints.items()}
+                for dep in row.get("deps", []):
+                    feature = dep.get("feature", "")
+                    if feature and feature not in features:
+                        continue
+                    dep_name = dep["name"]
+                    new_constraints.setdefault(dep_name, []).append(
+                        (dep["min"], dep["max"]))
+                search(new_assignments, new_constraints)
+
+        initial_constraints = {name: [tuple(bounds)]
+                               for name, bounds in roots.items()}
+        search({}, initial_constraints)
+        if best_install is None:
+            return {"error": "unsatisfiable"}
+        return {"versions": best_install}
     return solve
